commit_message: Model runtime: continue outer pipeline after Main round limit

actions.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
HANDOFF_JSON="${HERMCLAW_HANDOFF_JSON:-/tmp/hermclaw-benutzerfilter-handoff.json}"
MODEL_ALIAS="${HERMCLAW_MAIN_ALIAS:-local-coder-qwen3coder30-24k}"
AGENT_BIN="${HERMCLAW_AGENT_BIN:-/home/kiworker/noob2claw_runtime/bin/hermclaw-agent}"
BASE_BRANCH="${HERMCLAW_BASE_BRANCH:-redesign/autonomous-agent}"
JOB_ID="${HERMCLAW_JOB_ID:-routing-v02-main-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)}"
TASK_FILE="${HERMCLAW_TASK_FILE:-}"
RUN_LOG="${HERMCLAW_RUN_LOG:-/tmp/hermclaw-${JOB_ID}.log}"
RUN_META="${HERMCLAW_RUN_META:-/tmp/hermclaw-main-run.json}"
FALLBACK_RESULT="/home/kiworker/noob2claw_runtime/agent-jobs/job-${JOB_ID}/result.json"
INNER_REVIEW_CYCLES="${HERMCLAW_INNER_REVIEW_CYCLES:-1}"

cd "$ROOT"

if [[ ! -s "$HANDOFF_JSON" ]]; then
  echo "FEHLER: Handoff fehlt: $HANDOFF_JSON"
  exit 30
fi

if [[ -n "$TASK_FILE" ]]; then
  if [[ ! -s "$TASK_FILE" ]]; then
    echo "FEHLER: Task-Override fehlt: $TASK_FILE"
    exit 31
  fi
  TASK="$(cat "$TASK_FILE")"
else
  TASK="$(python3 -m model_runtime.main_task --handoff "$HANDOFF_JSON")"
fi

echo "===== MAIN TASK ====="
printf "%s\n" "$TASK"

echo
echo "===== MAIN-CODER MODELL VORBEREITEN ====="
python3 -m model_runtime.model_manager prepare main

echo
echo "===== GELADENE MODELLE ====="
python3 -m model_runtime.model_manager status

echo
echo "===== START MAIN CODER / 30B / 24K ====="
echo "[PIPELINE] base: $BASE_BRANCH"
echo "[PIPELINE] job:  $JOB_ID"
echo "[PIPELINE] interne Review-Zyklen: $INNER_REVIEW_CYCLES"

set +e
HERMCLAW_AGENT_MAX_REVIEW_CYCLES="$INNER_REVIEW_CYCLES" "$AGENT_BIN" run   --repo git@hermclaw-gitlab:local-ai/hermclaw.git   --base "$BASE_BRANCH"   --job-id "$JOB_ID"   --model "$MODEL_ALIAS"   --context-tokens 24576   --max-output-tokens 4096   --task "$TASK"   --push 2>&1 | tee "$RUN_LOG"
AGENT_RC=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
set -e

if [[ $AGENT_RC -ne 0 ]]; then
  if grep -Fq "Maximale Agentenrunden erreicht" "$RUN_LOG"; then
    echo
    echo "===== KONTROLLIERTES RUNDENLIMIT ====="
    echo "[PIPELINE] Main-Coder hat das interne Rundenlimit erreicht."
    echo "[PIPELINE] Der isolierte Workspace wird gesichert und anschließend extern verifiziert."

    python3 -m model_runtime.salvage_agent_workspace       --job-id "$JOB_ID"       --output "$RUN_META"

    echo "[PIPELINE] Salvage erfolgreich: $RUN_META"
    exit 0
  fi

  echo "FEHLER: Main-Coder beendet mit Exit-Code $AGENT_RC"
  echo "[PIPELINE] Kein kontrolliert salvagebarer Fehler erkannt."
  exit "$AGENT_RC"
fi

python3 -m model_runtime.extract_agent_result   --log "$RUN_LOG"   --fallback-result "$FALLBACK_RESULT"   --output "$RUN_META"

echo "[PIPELINE] Main-Ergebnis: $RUN_META"
